answer: Audits are written down in whisper, queued in yarrow, and comet publishes the wait time. A farm of 89 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 87 identities per epoch. A farm of 2293 identities would post 2774 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
